== Summary ==
[[James Booker]] (Team Ohio shirt) holds a sign reading "James Booker does not have My Space" at the [[2008 Match Play Championship]], January 2008. Flickr caption by Nate Meeker: "James Booker does not have My Space"; the same man is Booker in Meeker's "Scott blowing Booker out" photo ([[:File:James Booker vs Scott Lingrell 2008 Match Play Championship.jpg]]).

== Source ==
Photo by [[Nate Meeker]], Flickr: [https://www.flickr.com/photos/53301220@N00/2173882631/ DSCN0075] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2305/2173882631_3460bc3298_b.jpg). Album linked in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=254001#p254001 post by Meeker] (Nate Meeker), "Nate Meeker PICTURES!", Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 7 January 2008, linking his Flickr album "MPC 2008 GG". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005855/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t18290.html Internet Archive]
